Btc Capital Management Has Cut Apple (AAPL) Stake; Electronic Arts (EA)’s Sentiment Is 1.15 
January 15, 2018 - By Maria Brooks 
Btc Capital Management Inc decreased Apple Inc (AAPL) stake by 2.97% reported in 2017Q3 SEC filing. Btc Capital Management Inc sold 2,468 shares as Apple Inc (AAPL)’s stock rose 12.78%. The Btc Capital Management Inc holds 80,629 shares with $12.42 million value, down from 83,097 last quarter. Apple Inc now has $900.87 billion valuation. The stock increased 1.03% or $1.81 during the last trading session, reaching $177.09. About 25.42 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since January 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Electronic Arts Inc. develops, markets, publishes, and distributes games, content, and services for game consoles, personal computers, mobile phones, and tablets worldwide. The company has market cap of $34.84 billion. It develops and publishes games primarily under the Battlefield, Mass Effect, Need for Speed, The Sims, and Plants v. It has a 29.83 P/E ratio. Zombies brands; and license games from others, such as FIFA, Madden NFL, and Star Wars, as well as publishes and distributes games developed by third parties. 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on January, 30. They expect $3.75 earnings per share, up 11.61% or $0.39 from last year’s $3.36 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $19.08 billion for 11.81 P/E if the $3.75 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.07 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 81.16% EPS growth. 
Btc Capital Management Inc increased Ishares Tr (IWB) stake by 3,460 shares to 149,939 valued at $20.97M in 2017Q3. It also upped Broadcom Ltd stake by 1,883 shares and now owns 17,154 shares. Honeywell Intl Inc (NYSE:HON) was raised too.
